title: No Fire Overlay.
description: Removes fire texture for competitive advantage in Minecraft
body:
What it does
------------
This Pack provides visual competitive advantage by removing fire texture completely (including soul fire) (also removes cracking sound from fire)

**especially for late game pvp gamemodes like:**
- SMP
- Bed
- Cart (bow cart)
- Vanilla (Crystal PvP)
